goals.title: 사용자 요청: GitHub clone 폴더 C:\Users\A\Documents\Github Clone 파일\Branches...
goals.objective: 사용자 요청: GitHub clone 폴더 C:\Users\A\Documents\Github Clone 파일\Branches3.0-HTO3.0 에서 HTO/Branches 3.0 프로젝트를 읽고, 기본 기능은 유지하면서 HackTheBox와 비슷한 학습형 해킹 챌린지 게임 흐름으로 개선한다. 단, HackTheBox를 그대로 복제하지 말고 방식과 프론트엔드는 참고하되 독자적인 네온/사이버 학습 UI로 만든다. 사용자가 공부할 수 있게 문제를 제시하고, 마지막에 문제를 풀면 완료/성공 흐름이 가능하게 한다. 변경한 내용을 알려주고, 첨부 이미지처럼 프론트엔드/백엔드 구조와 수정 내용을 정리한다. 제약: 기존 코드와 기본 구조를 먼저 분석한다. 안전한 교육용 챌린지만 만든다. 실제 공격 대상/실서비스 침해 기능은 만들지 않는다. 프론트엔드는 네온 사인 분위기를 살리되 HackTheBox와 동일한 브랜딩/카피/디자인 복제는 피한다. 구현 후 실행 가능한 검증과 브라우저 QA 증거를 남긴다.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser use: start the frontend dev server from frontend with npm run start, open http://127.0.0.1:<port>/, select the final challenge, enter the correct flag BRANCHES{NEON_ROOT}, and observe the mission-complete panel with score/progress changed.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser use: open the lab page, submit an empty answer and then a malformed answer such as HTB{copycat}; observe accessible feedback that no completion is awarded and hints remain educational/safe.

successCriteria.scenario: Command + browser regression: verify existing frontend/dist/index.html remains present and unchanged in role, backend TypeScript build still passes, and the new frontend start script serves without deleting the old built app.

goals.evidence: C001-C003 all pass: browser happy/edge screenshots and regression command evidence captured with cleanup receipts.

goals.title: 사진형 구조 정리와 변경 요약
goals.objective: Create a concise structure/change guide, modeled after the user's reference image, that documents the frontend/backend folder structure, the added Neon Lab files, how to run it, and what was intentionally left unchanged.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser use: open the lab page and verify it contains a structure guide section with frontend/backend columns, added files, run command, and unchanged dist/backend boundaries.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G002-C001-browser-structure.png plus action log and cleanup receipt.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G002-C001-browser-structure.png and .log: browser QA found Current repo shape guide, frontend/backend columns, dist boundary, and unchanged backend note | cleanup: closed Playwright Chrome context; closed in-app tab where available; stopped Vite session 70012; no listeners on :5177

successCriteria.scenario: Command/data check: parse the markdown guide and verify it references the actual added files, frontend/backend structure, and safe-run instructions without claiming backend changes that were not made.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G002-C002-doc-check.txt containing parsed checks and cleanup receipt.

successCriteria.scenario: Command regression: run git status --short and a file existence check to prove the guide/doc additions did not remove existing README, frontend/docs iteration notes, frontend/dist, or backend files.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G002-C003-regression.txt containing status and file existence checks plus cleanup receipt.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G002-C003-regression.txt: README, old problem-bank docs, frontend/dist, and backend/src still exist; git status shows only intended additions/modifications | cleanup: closed Playwright Chrome context; closed in-app tab where available; stopped Vite session 70012; no listeners on :5177
